about: What GOV.UK says about part-time pay, for tools/build-pro-rata-pages.js. Tax figures come from the UK tax files.

proRata.quote: Some benefits are applied ‘pro rata’ (in proportion to hours worked). For example, if a full-time worker gets a £1,000 Christmas bonus, and a part-time worker works half the number of hours, they should get £500.

sameRates.quote: Part-time workers should get the same treatment for: pay rates (including sick pay, maternity, paternity and adoption leave and pay); pension opportunities and benefits; holidays …

fullTime.quote: There is no specific number of hours that makes someone full or part-time, but a full-time worker will usually work 35 hours or more a week.

overtime.quote: Overtime pay - part-time workers may not get overtime pay until they’ve worked over the normal hours of a full-time worker.
